rubrics.justification: The response overstates what is visible in the image, confidently confirming a full 3AA with large blastocoel, compact ICM, and cohesive TE despite the image showing only a limited peripheral view with no clear global assessment of blastocoel or ICM possible.

It integrates maternal age, prior outcomes, diagnosis, BMI, endometrium, sperm factors, and prior live birth reasonably well with embryo quality, though some inferences are stronger than the available data support.

The overall logic is structured, but it makes several speculative leaps, especially labeling the case high-risk and attributing prior outcomes mainly to aneuploidy or implantation dysfunction without sufficient evidence.

Some recommendations are standard (eSET, luteal support, consideration of further workup), but others such as routine aspirin, LMWH, corticosteroids, ERA/EMMA/ALICE, and calling PGT-A mandatory are not broadly guideline-supported for this presentation.
The response gives clear next-step recommendations for transfer management and future evaluation, though several suggested interventions are overly aggressive or insufficiently evidence-based.
